title: Small Kazhdan constants for small generating sets of linear groups
summary: Let G be a linear group with Kazhdan property (T) generated by d elements. We show that there are generating sets of size d+2 with arbitrarily small Kazhdan constants. We also prove the same conclusion for every finitely generated group admitting a non-elementary convergence action on a compact metrizable space. This includes non-elementary word-hyperbolic and relatively hyperbolic groups, as well as finitely generated non-elementary subgroups of word-hyperbolic groups.
